references.title: NoirsBoxes — MD-903 / MD-905 Smart Charger & Power Adapter Detector

drafts.caption:
Is that fast charger really fast — or quietly counterfeit?

The MD-903 / MD-905 plugs in and tells you in 5 seconds: original, Taiwan-made, third-party, or counterfeit, with a clear rating score on its 3-inch color screen.

Real-time readout of max power, PD/QC protocol, open-circuit voltage, output power, ripple noise, and rise/fall time — the numbers your QC checklist actually needs. OTA firmware keeps the protocol database current, so new chargers don't outrun your tester.

Built for 3C retailers, repair shops, Amazon/Shopee sellers, and OEM/ODM QC lines.
